const scan=(p,n,s)=>{for(const [t,re] of [[\"known-key\",/(?:sk-(?:proj-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{16,}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{16,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{25,})/g],[\"jwt\",/eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}/g],[\"url-credential\",/[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\\/\\/[^\\s:@/]+:[^\\s@/]+@/gi]]){for(const m of s.matchAll(re))add(p,n,t,m[0])} for(const m of s.matchAll(/(?:api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|passwd|credential|authorization|auth)[A-Za-z0-9_-]*\\s*(?:=|:)\\s*[\"'\"']([^\"'\"'\\s]{8,})[\"'\"']/gi))add(p,n,\"keyword-literal\",m[1]); for(const m of s.matchAll(/(?:export\\s+)?(?:[A-Z0-9_]*(?:API_KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|PASSWD|CREDENTIAL|AUTH)[A-Z0-9_]*)=([^\\s;]{8,})/g))add(p,n,\"shell-secret-assignment\",m[1]); for(const m of s.matchAll(/[\"'\"']([A-Za-z0-9_+\\/=.-]{32,})[\"'\"']/g)){const v=m[1]; if(/[A-Za-z]/.test(v)&&/[0-9]/.test(v)&&!/^https?:/.test(v)&&!/^[-a-z]+(?:[-.][a-z]+)+$/.test(v))add(p,n,\"long-literal\",v)}}; const diff=run([\"git\",\"diff\",\"--unified=0\",\"--no-color\"]); let p=\"\",ln=0; for(const l of diff.split(\"\\n\")){if(l.startsWith(\"+++ b/\"))p=l.slice(6); else if(l.startsWith(\"@@\")){const m=l.match(/\\+(\\d+)/);ln=m?Number(m[1]):0}else if(l.startsWith(\"+\")&&!l.startsWith(\"+++\")){scan(p,ln,l.slice(1));ln++}else if(!l.startsWith(\"-\")&&!l.startsWith(\"\\\\\"))ln++} const us=run([\"git\",\"ls-files\",\"--others\",\"--exclude-standard\"]).trim().split(\"\\n\").filter(Boolean); for(const p of us){const f=Bun.file(p); if((await f.size)>5000000)continue; const b=new Uint8Array(await f.arrayBuffer()); if(b.includes(0))continue; const s=d.decode(b); s.split(\"\\n\").forEach((l,i)=>scan(p,i+1,l))} rows.sort((a,b)=>a.file.localeCompare(b.file)||a.line-b.line); console.log(JSON.stringify(rows,null,2));'","workdir":"/home/diogenes/Projects/keating","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000});
